# Poller

Waits on many sockets at once.

```rux
pub struct Poller {
    // private fields
}
```

Not copied.

## Methods

<h3 id="register"><code>Register</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Register(
    self: &var Poller,
    source: PollSource,
    token: uint64,
    interest: Interest
) -> ! IoError
```

Watches `source` for `interest`, reporting it with `token`.

| Name       | Type         | Description                                |
| ---------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------ |
| `source`   | `PollSource` | the socket                                 |
| `token`    | `uint64`     | the word reported with the socket's events |
| `interest` | `Interest`   | the readiness wanted                       |

**Returns**: success, or `AlreadyExists` when the socket is registered already

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Net/Src/Poll.rux#L159)

<h3 id="wait"><code>Wait</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Wait(
    self: &var Poller,
    events: var PollEvent[..],
    timeout: Duration?
) -> uint ! IoError
```

Waits until a registered socket is ready or `timeout` passes, and reports the ready sockets into `events`.

| Name      | Type                | Description                                                                                  |
| --------- | ------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `events`  | `var PollEvent[..]` | room for the events; a wait reports at most this many, and the rest are reported by the next |
| `timeout` | `Duration?`         | how long to wait, zero to only look, or `none` to wait without end                           |

**Returns**: how many events were filled; zero after the timeout or when a signal ended the wait early

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Net/Src/Poll.rux#L200)

<h3 id="poll-source"><code>PollSource</code></h3>

```rux
pub struct PollSource {
    // private fields
}
```

A socket as a [`Poller`](/docs/api/net/poller) watches it, from the socket's `PollSource`. It does not keep the socket open, so it is
deregistered before the socket is dropped. `Copy`.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Net/Src/Poll.rux#L68)

<h3 id="poll-event"><code>PollEvent</code></h3>

```rux
pub struct PollEvent {
    pub token: uint64;
    pub readable: bool;
    pub writable: bool;
    pub closed: bool;
}
```

One socket a wait found ready. `Copy`.
A socket ready both to read and to write may be reported once with both, or once for each.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Net/Src/Poll.rux#L75)

**Fields**

| Name       | Type     | Description                                                                                   |
| ---------- | -------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `token`    | `uint64` | The token the socket was registered with.                                                     |
| `readable` | `bool`   | A read would not wait, or a listener has a connection to accept.                              |
| `writable` | `bool`   | A write would not wait.                                                                       |
| `closed`   | `bool`   | The peer has closed the connection or an error is pending; the next read or write says which. |
